minutes.headline: Planning Board approved Village Center District bylaw amendments for Town Meeting and endorsed an ANR plan.
minutes.summary: The board held a public hearing on two protective bylaw amendments tied to the Village Center District, closed it and approved the amendments. It also approved prior minutes, heard committee reports, reviewed an ANR plan for Sunny Hill Road, and discussed Town Meeting preparation, open board seats, stormwater and Pope Road access.

what_happened.line: The Planning Board closed the public hearing and approved the two Village Center District bylaw amendments, sections 5.2 and 8.4, for Town Meeting.
The board agreed to ask the Selectmen and other boards for support of the Village Center and APD bylaws before Town Meeting.
The board reviewed an ANR plan for Sunny Hill Road and endorsed it; no vote was required.
The board will tell other boards it plans to sign ANR plans on the first night with a new stamp, rather than routing them to other boards first.
Stormwater discussion was put on the April 27 agenda instead of the 13th.

why_it_matters: The Village Center District amendments are headed to Town Meeting, where residents will be asked to vote on them, and they change the zoning rules for the village center.
Signing ANR plans on the first night would shorten how long landowners wait for approval to divide land without a subdivision review.
